senses.en: to change a book or play for film or television
senses.pattern: adapt a novel for television / be adapted from / be adapted into a film
senses.example: The best-selling novel was [[adapted]] for television and became the most-watched drama of the year.
senses.example_zh: 這本暢銷小說被改編成電視劇，成為當年收視率最高的戲劇。

senses.en: to change something to suit a new use
senses.pattern: adapt a room for / be adapted for use / specially adapted
senses.example: The old school bus has been [[adapted]] to serve as a mobile library for children in mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 這輛舊校車已被改裝成行動圖書館，服務山區村落的孩子。

gsat.sentence: The movie director [[adapted]] this year’s bestseller into a hit and made a fortune.
He saw no reason why this could not be [[adapted]] for use on the busy London intersections.

senses.en: the practical use of something
senses.pattern: practical applications / the application of technology / have wide applications
senses.example: The new material has many practical [[applications]], from lighter airplanes to stronger bicycle frames.
senses.example_zh: 這種新材料有許多實際應用，從更輕的飛機到更堅固的腳踏車車架都用得上。

senses.en: the act of putting a substance onto a surface
senses.pattern: the application of sunscreen / regular application / for external application only
senses.example: Regular [[application]] of sunscreen is necessary if you plan to stay outdoors all afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 如果你打算整個下午待在戶外，就必須定時塗抹防曬乳。
senses.note: 動詞 apply 也有「塗、敷」之意

gsat.sentence: Today, the ancient art form has found a new [[application]] in the hands of contemporary artists.

senses.en: weapons, especially those used by an army
senses.pattern: take up arms / lay down one's arms / the arms race / arms control
senses.example: After years of fighting, the rebels finally agreed to lay down their [[arms]] and join the peace talks.
senses.example_zh: 經過多年戰鬥，叛軍終於同意放下武器，加入和平談判。
senses.note: 恆用複數；動詞 arm 為「武裝」

senses.en: the people or organizations with official power
senses.pattern: the local authorities / the health authorities / report sth to the authorities
senses.example: The local [[authorities]] closed the beach after several swimmers were stung by jellyfish.
senses.example_zh: 數名泳客被水母螫傷後，地方當局關閉了這片海灘。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 the authorities

senses.en: a person with special knowledge of a subject
senses.pattern: an authority on / a leading authority / a world authority on
senses.example: Professor Lin is a leading [[authority]] on ancient coins, so museums often ask for her advice.
senses.example_zh: 林教授是古錢幣方面首屈一指的權威人士，因此博物館常向她請教。

gsat.sentence: In medieval Europe, on the other hand, travel documents were issued by local [[authorities]], and generally contained a list of towns and cities which the document holder was permitted to enter or pass through.

However, a man known as Mestre Bimba devoted a great deal of time and effort to convincing the Brazilian [[authorities]] that Capoeira has great cultural value and should become an official fighting style.

senses.en: having no money at all
senses.pattern: be flat broke / go broke / be completely broke
senses.example: I can't join the trip this weekend because I'm completely [[broke]] until payday.
senses.example_zh: 這個週末的旅行我去不了，因為在發薪日之前我完全沒錢。
senses.note: 口語用法；不放在名詞前

gsat.sentence: She didn’t have any insurance, so she went [[broke]] because of her illness.

senses.en: the group of top ministers who lead a government
senses.pattern: a cabinet minister / a cabinet meeting / a cabinet reshuffle / form a cabinet
senses.example: The new prime minister chose experts rather than party members to serve in her [[cabinet]].
senses.example_zh: 新任首相挑選專家而非黨內成員進入她的內閣。

senses.en: a person applying for a job or being considered for it
senses.pattern: a job candidate / interview candidates / a suitable candidate for the post
senses.example: After interviewing twelve [[candidates]], the manager offered the job to a recent graduate with no experience.
senses.example_zh: 面試了十二位應徵者之後，經理把這份工作給了一位毫無經驗的應屆畢業生。

senses.en: a person or thing suitable for or likely to get something
senses.pattern: a good candidate for surgery / a prime candidate for / a likely candidate
senses.example: Doctors say that patients who are otherwise healthy are the best [[candidates]] for this kind of knee surgery.
senses.example_zh: 醫師表示，其他方面都健康的病人是最適合接受這種膝蓋手術的對象。

gsat.sentence: Since Michael was the best [[candidate]], the committee voted unanimously for him to take charge of the company’s sales department.

senses.en: a set of rules about how people should behave
senses.pattern: a code of conduct / a dress code / a moral code / a code of ethics
senses.example: The school's [[code]] of conduct clearly states that cheating on tests will not be tolerated.
senses.example_zh: 該校的行為準則明訂，考試作弊絕不寬貸。

senses.en: a set of official laws or regulations
senses.pattern: the building code / a fire safety code / the civil code / the tax code
senses.example: The old theater was closed because it failed to meet the city's fire safety [[code]].
senses.example_zh: 這家老戲院因不符合該市的消防安全法規而關閉。

gsat.sentence: Many employees don’t like a conservative dress [[code]].
Supporters of casual office wear also argue that a casual dress [[code]] helps them save money.

senses.en: to fail suddenly and completely
senses.pattern: the economy collapses / the talks collapsed / the company collapsed
senses.example: The country's banking system nearly [[collapsed]] during the crisis, and thousands of families lost their savings.
senses.example_zh: 該國的銀行體系在那場危機中幾乎崩潰，數千個家庭失去了積蓄。

senses.en: to fall down suddenly because of illness or tiredness
senses.pattern: collapse from exhaustion / collapse on the floor / collapse into a chair
senses.example: One runner [[collapsed]] from the heat just ten meters before the finish line and was rushed to the hospital.
senses.example_zh: 一名跑者在終點線前僅十公尺處因高溫而昏倒，隨即被緊急送醫。

gsat.sentence: The kingdom began to [[collapse]] after the death of its ruler, and was soon taken over by a neighboring country.
As Deborah shuffled sideways to block the player, her knee went out and she [[collapsed]] on the court in burning pain.

senses.en: the people or companies you are competing against
senses.pattern: beat the competition / stay ahead of the competition / keep an eye on the competition
senses.example: To stay ahead of the [[competition]], the small bakery introduces two new kinds of bread every month.
senses.example_zh: 為了領先競爭對手，這家小麵包店每個月都推出兩種新口味的麵包。

senses.en: the parts or substances that something is made of
senses.pattern: chemical composition / the composition of the soil / household composition
senses.example: Scientists analyzed the chemical [[composition]] of the rock brought back from the moon.
senses.example_zh: 科學家分析了從月球帶回的岩石的化學成分。

senses.en: a piece of music or art that someone has created
senses.pattern: a musical composition / an original composition / perform a composition
senses.example: The young pianist performed one of her own [[compositions]] at the school concert.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家在學校音樂會上演奏了一首自己創作的樂曲。

gsat.sentence: Of course, in determining overall standards of living of Americans, factors such as household [[composition]] and family size need also to be taken into consideration.

senses.en: to bring or come together in one place
senses.pattern: be concentrated in / concentrate power / concentrate resources on
senses.example: Most of the country's population is [[concentrated]] along the coast, where the land is flat and fertile.
senses.example_zh: 該國大部分人口集中在沿海地區，那裡地勢平坦、土壤肥沃。

senses.en: a substance made stronger by removing water
senses.pattern: orange juice concentrate / tomato concentrate / made from concentrate
senses.example: This apple juice is made from [[concentrate]], so water was added back before it was bottled.
senses.example_zh: 這款蘋果汁是由濃縮液還原製成，所以裝瓶前又把水加了回去。

gsat.sentence: Scientists found that sharp corners are natural weak spots where stress [[concentrates]].
A book town is a rural town in which second-hand and antiquarian bookshops are [[concentrated]].

senses.en: trust that a secret will not be told to others
senses.pattern: in confidence / in strict confidence / take sb into one's confidence
senses.example: I'm telling you this in strict [[confidence]], so please don't mention it to anyone in class.
senses.example_zh: 我是在絕對保密的前提下告訴你這件事的，所以請不要跟班上任何人提起。

senses.en: a secret that you tell someone you trust
senses.pattern: share confidences / exchange confidences / betray a confidence
senses.example: The two roommates stayed up late sharing [[confidences]] about their families and their fears.
senses.example_zh: 兩位室友熬夜到很晚，互相吐露關於家庭和內心恐懼的祕密。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞，常用複數

senses.en: importance or significance
senses.pattern: of no consequence / of little consequence / a matter of great consequence
senses.example: The color of the cover is of little [[consequence]]; what matters is whether the book is useful.
senses.example_zh: 封面的顏色沒什麼重要性；要緊的是這本書實不實用。
senses.note: 此義不可數，常用 of little/no ~

senses.en: to look in a book or map for information
senses.pattern: consult a dictionary / consult a map / consult the manual / consult one's notes
senses.example: Lost in the old town, the tourists stopped to [[consult]] the map on the station wall.
senses.example_zh: 在舊城區迷路後，遊客們停下來查閱車站牆上的地圖。

senses.en: to formally oppose or argue against a decision
senses.pattern: contest a decision / contest a will / contest a fine
senses.example: The driver decided to [[contest]] the parking fine because the sign had been hidden by a tree.
senses.example_zh: 那位駕駛決定對違規停車的罰單提出異議，因為標誌被樹擋住了。

senses.en: to compete to win a position or prize
senses.pattern: contest an election / contest a seat / contest the title
senses.example: Eight teams from across the country will [[contest]] the national title in the final round.
senses.example_zh: 來自全國各地的八支隊伍將在決賽階段角逐全國冠軍。

senses.en: to be one of the causes of something
senses.pattern: contribute to / contribute to global warming / a contributing factor
senses.example: Doctors warn that too little sleep can [[contribute]] to weight gain and poor memory.
senses.example_zh: 醫師警告，睡眠不足可能是體重增加和記憶力變差的原因之一。
senses.note: 後接 to，to 為介系詞

senses.en: to write something for a newspaper, magazine, or book
senses.pattern: contribute an article to / contribute to a magazine / contribute a column
senses.example: My English teacher regularly [[contributes]] short stories to a magazine for young readers.
senses.example_zh: 我的英文老師定期向一本青少年雜誌投稿短篇小說。

gsat.sentence: Various factors have thus [[contributed]] to the phenomenon of smiling. As many psychologists now point out, this simple gesture is in fact far more complicated than it may appear.
The last factor [[contributing]] to the disappearance of coral reefs is people.

senses.en: a traditional or generally accepted way of doing something
senses.pattern: by convention / social conventions / follow convention / break with convention
senses.example: By [[convention]], the youngest member of the family pours tea for the elders first.
senses.example_zh: 依照慣例，家中最年幼的成員要先為長輩倒茶。

senses.en: a formal agreement between countries
senses.pattern: sign a convention / an international convention / a convention on human rights
senses.example: More than one hundred countries have signed the [[convention]] on protecting endangered wild animals.
senses.example_zh: 已有一百多個國家簽署了保護瀕危野生動物的公約。

gsat.sentence: From the late 1850s until his death in 1910, Winslow Homer produced a body of work distinguished by its thoughtful expression and its independence from artistic [[conventions]].
Generally there are two ways to name typhoons: the number-based [[convention]] and the list-based convention.

senses.en: to argue against or act against something
senses.pattern: counter a claim / counter an argument / counter a threat / counter the effects of
senses.example: To [[counter]] the spread of false health rumors online, the hospital began posting short videos by its doctors.
senses.example_zh: 為了對抗網路上不實健康謠言的散播，醫院開始發布由院內醫師拍攝的短片。

senses.en: in a way that is opposite to something
senses.pattern: run counter to / go counter to / act counter to sb's wishes
senses.example: The manager's decision to cut training ran [[counter]] to everything the company had promised its new employees.
senses.example_zh: 經理刪減培訓的決定，與公司對新進員工的一切承諾背道而馳。
senses.note: 固定搭配：run counter to＋名詞

gsat.sentence: Recent research has found lots of evidence to [[counter]] the drug company’s claims about its “miracle” tablets for curing cancer.
This seems to run [[counter]] to the common practice. When people have sprained a muscle or tendon, they are usually advised not to go right back to exercising until the pain goes away.

senses.en: to defeat completely or stop by force
senses.pattern: crush an opponent / crush a rebellion / crush the opposition
senses.example: The home team [[crushed]] their rivals by eight goals and moved easily into the final.
senses.example_zh: 地主隊以八球之差徹底擊敗對手，輕鬆晉級決賽。

senses.en: to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed
senses.pattern: be crushed by the news / crush somebody's hopes / crush somebody's spirit
senses.example: Mia was [[crushed]] when she learned that she had not been chosen for the school band.
senses.example_zh: 米亞得知自己沒被選進學校樂隊時，感到極度沮喪。

senses.en: a long period of very low economic activity
senses.pattern: an economic depression / the Great Depression / a severe depression
senses.example: During the [[depression]], many factories closed and millions of workers could not find jobs.
senses.example_zh: 經濟蕭條期間，許多工廠倒閉，數百萬名工人找不到工作。
senses.note: the Great Depression：1930 年代經濟大蕭條

senses.en: an area of low air pressure, often bringing rain
senses.pattern: a tropical depression / a deep depression / an approaching depression
senses.example: A tropical [[depression]] east of the island is expected to bring heavy rain this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 島嶼東方的熱帶性低氣壓預計本週末將帶來豪雨。
senses.note: 也可指地面的「窪地、凹陷處」

senses.en: an illness of the mind or body
senses.pattern: an eating disorder / a sleep disorder / a mental disorder / a rare genetic disorder
senses.example: Her doctor said the constant tiredness was caused by a sleep [[disorder]], not by laziness.
senses.example_zh: 醫生說她持續的疲倦是睡眠障礙造成的，而不是因為懶惰。

gsat.sentence: Terrence Power, for example, complained that after his wife learned she had Wegener’s disease, an uncommon [[disorder]] of the immune system, they found it difficult to refuse testing recommended by her physician.
The soybean’s high fiber content is beneficial in preventing digestive [[disorders]].

senses.en: the general meaning of what someone says
senses.pattern: get the drift / catch sb's drift / the general drift of
senses.example: I couldn't understand every word of the French speech, but I got the general [[drift]] of it.
senses.example_zh: 那場法語演講我沒辦法每個字都聽懂，但聽懂了它的大意。

senses.zh: 漫無目的地漂泊；漸漸轉向
senses.en: to move or change gradually without a clear plan
senses.pattern: drift from job to job / drift apart / drift toward
senses.example: Without clear goals, he [[drifted]] from one part-time job to another for several years.
senses.example_zh: 由於沒有明確目標，他好幾年都漫無目的地換過一份又一份兼職。

gsat.sentence: In his early adulthood, he even [[drifted]] toward communism.

senses.en: careful use of money, fuel, or time
senses.pattern: fuel economy / for reasons of economy / economy class
senses.example: Hybrid cars are popular with commuters because of their excellent fuel [[economy]] in city traffic.
senses.example_zh: 油電混合車很受通勤族歡迎，因為在市區行駛時十分節省燃油。

senses.en: a country seen as an economic system
senses.pattern: an emerging economy / a developing economy / the world's largest economies
senses.example: India is now one of the fastest-growing major [[economies]] in the world.
senses.example_zh: 印度現在是全球成長最快的主要經濟體之一。

gsat.sentence: Pacific islands like the Galápagos, Easter Island, and Tahiti, have [[economies]] that are driven almost completely by tourism.

senses.en: a natural ability to do something easily
senses.pattern: a facility for languages / a facility with words / great facility
senses.example: Having grown up in three countries, Mia has an amazing [[facility]] for learning languages.
senses.example_zh: 米亞在三個國家長大，有驚人的語言學習天賦。
senses.note: 此義常用單數，後接 for 或 with

senses.en: the production of something, especially electricity or heat
senses.pattern: power generation / electricity generation / the generation of heat
senses.example: Burning coal for the [[generation]] of electricity releases large amounts of carbon dioxide into the air.
senses.example_zh: 為了產生電力而燃燒煤炭，會把大量二氧化碳排放到空氣中。
senses.note: power generation 發電；動詞 generate

senses.en: to make people or animals move together as a group
senses.pattern: herd cattle / herd sheep / herd tourists onto a bus
senses.example: The guide [[herded]] the tired tourists onto the bus before the heavy rain began.
senses.example_zh: 大雨落下之前，導遊把疲憊的遊客全趕上了遊覽車。

senses.en: a large group of people who all behave alike
senses.pattern: follow the herd / herd mentality / herd instinct
senses.example: Instead of following the [[herd]], Lily chose a major that truly interested her.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉不跟隨盲從的群眾，而是選了自己真正感興趣的科系。

senses.en: to make someone very interested or addicted
senses.pattern: be hooked on / get hooked on / hook the reader
senses.example: My brother got [[hooked]] on the detective series after watching just one episode.
senses.example_zh: 我弟弟只看了一集，就對那部偵探影集著迷了。
senses.note: 常用被動 be / get hooked on

senses.en: something designed to catch people's attention
senses.pattern: a catchy hook / an opening hook / a sales hook
senses.example: Every good speech needs a [[hook]] in its first minute to keep the audience listening.
senses.example_zh: 每場好演講都需要在第一分鐘有個吸引人的亮點，才能讓聽眾繼續聽下去。

senses.en: the process of giving birth to a baby
senses.pattern: go into labor / be in labor / a difficult labor / labor pains
senses.example: She went into [[labor]] at midnight, and her daughter was born early the next morning.
senses.example_zh: 她在午夜開始分娩，女兒在隔天清晨出生。

senses.en: to work hard or move with great effort
senses.pattern: labor over a report / labor up the hill / labor to finish
senses.example: The old truck [[labored]] up the steep mountain road, with black smoke pouring from its engine.
senses.example_zh: 那輛老舊卡車艱難地爬上陡峭的山路，引擎不斷冒出黑煙。

senses.en: to introduce a new product or start an activity
senses.pattern: launch a product / launch a campaign / launch an attack / launch a website
senses.example: The company plans to [[launch]] its first electric scooter in Asia next spring.
senses.example_zh: 該公司計劃明年春天在亞洲推出第一款電動機車。

senses.en: the event of introducing a new product or plan
senses.pattern: a product launch / a book launch / the launch of a campaign
senses.example: Hundreds of reporters attended the [[launch]] of the new smartphone last Friday.
senses.example_zh: 上週五有數百名記者出席了這款新智慧型手機的發表會。

gsat.sentence: To begin with, these staircases were quite narrow, so attackers would have to ascend one at a time, making it impossible to [[launch]] a mass attack.
To promote the new product, the company offered some free samples before they officially [[launched]] it.

senses.en: thin and fit; (of meat) containing little fat
senses.pattern: lean meat / a lean body / lean and fit
senses.example: Years of long-distance running had given the old farmer a [[lean]], strong body.
senses.example_zh: 多年的長跑讓這位老農夫擁有精瘦而結實的身材。

senses.en: (of a period) difficult, with little money or food
senses.pattern: lean years / lean times / a lean season
senses.example: During the [[lean]] years after the factory closed, many families in town could barely pay their rent.
senses.example_zh: 工廠關閉後那幾年不景氣，鎮上許多家庭幾乎付不出房租。

senses.en: the different parts or people that form something
senses.pattern: genetic makeup / chemical makeup / the makeup of the team
senses.example: The [[makeup]] of the national team has changed a lot, with six new players under twenty.
senses.example_zh: 國家隊的成員組成改變很大，有六名二十歲以下的新球員。

senses.en: a test taken later to replace a missed one
senses.pattern: a makeup exam / a makeup test / take a makeup
senses.example: Students who missed the midterm because of the flu may take a [[makeup]] next Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 因流感而錯過期中考的學生，可以在下週五下午參加補考。
senses.note: 美式用法；makeup class 指「補課」

senses.en: apart from that; in every other way
senses.pattern: an otherwise perfect day / otherwise healthy / otherwise excellent
senses.example: One spelling mistake spoiled an [[otherwise]] excellent essay about life in the countryside.
senses.example_zh: 這篇描寫鄉間生活的文章在其他方面都很出色，卻被一個拼字錯誤破壞了。

senses.en: differently; in another or opposite way
senses.pattern: think otherwise / say otherwise / prove otherwise / unless otherwise stated
senses.example: Everyone expected the old bridge to fall down, but the engineers' tests proved [[otherwise]].
senses.example_zh: 大家都以為那座老橋會倒塌，但工程師的測試卻證明事實正好相反。

senses.en: belonging only to one person, place, or thing
senses.pattern: be peculiar to / peculiar to the region / a problem peculiar to big cities
senses.example: The habit of bowing to the sea before fishing is [[peculiar]] to this small coastal town.
senses.example_zh: 出海捕魚前先向大海鞠躬，是這個濱海小鎮特有的習慣。
senses.note: 常用 be peculiar to＋地方／群體

senses.en: the act of mentioning someone or something
senses.pattern: make reference to / a reference to / make no reference to / with reference to
senses.example: In her speech, the principal made no [[reference]] to the rumor about closing the library.
senses.example_zh: 校長在致詞中完全沒有提及關閉圖書館的傳聞。

senses.en: a letter about your character, or the person writing it
senses.pattern: write a reference / ask for a reference / a job reference / list someone as a reference
senses.example: My former teacher kindly agreed to write a [[reference]] for my scholarship application.
senses.example_zh: 我以前的老師很好心地答應為我的獎學金申請寫推薦信。

gsat.sentence: In fact, there is documented [[reference]] to the ringing of bells even before the cathedral’s construction was completed, dating as far back as the 12th century.
In the Old Testament, [[reference]] is made to spiral staircases in the Temple of Solomon, suggesting that they were already in use by around 1,000 BC.

senses.en: a feeling of doubt about a plan or idea
senses.pattern: have reservations about / express reservations / without reservation
senses.example: I still have some [[reservations]] about the plan, but I am willing to give it a try.
senses.example_zh: 我對這項計畫仍有些疑慮，但願意試試看。

senses.en: an area of land kept for Native Americans
senses.pattern: live on a reservation / a Native American reservation / grow up on a reservation
senses.example: The writer grew up on a [[reservation]] in Arizona and often writes about tribal traditions.
senses.example_zh: 這位作家在亞利桑那州的原住民保留區長大，常書寫部落傳統。

gsat.sentence: The woman told the truth to her lawyer without [[reservation]] because he was the only person she could rely on.

senses.en: to go to bed
senses.pattern: retire to bed / retire early / retire for the night
senses.example: Grandfather usually [[retires]] at nine o'clock and gets up before sunrise to water his garden.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺通常九點就寢，日出前就起床澆花。
senses.note: 正式用語，口語用 go to bed

senses.en: to leave a place and go somewhere quieter
senses.pattern: retire to one's room / retire to the library / the jury retired
senses.example: After dinner, the guests [[retired]] to the living room for tea and quiet conversation.
senses.example_zh: 晚餐後，賓客們退到客廳喝茶、輕聲聊天。

senses.en: an important news story reported before anyone else
senses.pattern: get a scoop / a big scoop / a major scoop
senses.example: The young reporter got the biggest [[scoop]] of her career when she was the first to interview the rescued climber.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕記者搶先訪問到那名獲救的登山客，拿到她職業生涯中最大的獨家新聞。

senses.en: to make time or money available for someone
senses.pattern: spare a few minutes / spare the time / spare some change / can't spare
senses.example: Could you [[spare]] ten minutes after class to look at my science fair report?
senses.example_zh: 你下課後可以撥出十分鐘，看看我的科展報告嗎？

senses.en: to not harm someone; to save from something unpleasant
senses.pattern: spare sb's life / spare sb the trouble / be spared from / spare sb's feelings
senses.example: The typhoon destroyed the coastal villages but [[spared]] the capital, where only light rain fell.
senses.example_zh: 颱風摧毀了沿海的村莊，卻放過了首都，那裡只下了小雨。

senses.en: to avoid using or giving effort or money
senses.pattern: spare no effort / spare no expense / no expense was spared
senses.example: The city [[spared]] no expense in building a library that every resident could be proud of.
senses.example_zh: 該市毫不吝惜經費，興建了一座讓每位市民都引以為傲的圖書館。

gsat.sentence: They wrote letters to the tuna companies and supermarkets asking them to find a way to [[spare]] dolphins.
The Ethiopian government has [[spared]] no efforts in promoting running.

senses.en: to be the time or place of an event
senses.pattern: the century witnessed / witness great changes / witness rapid growth
senses.example: The last century [[witnessed]] remarkable progress in medicine and public health.
senses.example_zh: 上個世紀見證了醫學和公共衛生的非凡進步。

senses.en: evidence or proof that something is true
senses.pattern: bear witness to / be witness to / stand as witness to
senses.example: The ruined walls bear [[witness]] to the terrible flood that struck the town decades ago.
senses.example_zh: 殘破的牆壁見證了數十年前侵襲這座城鎮的可怕洪水。

gsat.sentence: The 1960s and ’70s [[witnessed]] the development of most modern stunt technology, like air rams and bullet squibs.

quiz.stem: The weather forecast promised sunshine all weekend, but the dark clouds gathering over the mountains suggested ______.
quiz.explain_zh: otherwise＝相反地。預報說整個週末放晴，但山頭聚集的烏雲顯示情況並非如此。

quiz.stem: In the United States, it is a social ______ to tip waiters at least fifteen percent of the bill, although no law requires it.
quiz.explain_zh: convention＝慣例。給服務生小費是社會慣例，並非法律規定。

quiz.stem: Laboratory tests showed that the chemical ______ of the water in the two rivers is quite different, which explains why different fish live in them.
quiz.explain_zh: makeup＝組成。化驗顯示兩條河河水的化學組成不同，所以魚種也不同。

quiz.stem: The runner plans to ______ the judges' decision, insisting that the video clearly shows she crossed the finish line first.
quiz.explain_zh: contest＝對…提出異議。跑者堅稱影片顯示她先衝線，打算對裁判的判決提出異議。

quiz.stem: The weather bureau warned that a tropical ______ forming over the ocean could strengthen into a typhoon within two days.
quiz.explain_zh: depression＝低氣壓。氣象局警告海面上的熱帶性低氣壓可能增強為颱風。

quiz.stem: To help his players stay in shape, the coach told them to choose ______ meat such as chicken breast and to avoid anything fried or fatty.
quiz.explain_zh: lean＝（肉）瘦的。教練要球員選雞胸肉之類的瘦肉，避開油炸或高脂食物。

quiz.stem: Although the new exam policy sounds promising, several teachers have expressed serious ______ about whether it can actually reduce students' stress.
quiz.explain_zh: reservation＝疑慮、保留意見。幾位老師對新政策能否減輕學生壓力深表疑慮。

quiz.stem: This species of butterfly is ______ to the high mountains of the island and has never been seen anywhere else in the world.
quiz.explain_zh: peculiar＝特有的。這種蝴蝶是島上高山所特有，別處從未見過。

quiz.stem: Thanks to an early warning sent to every phone, most residents escaped in time and were ______ the worst effects of the flood.
quiz.explain_zh: spare＝使免於。居民因預警及時逃離，免於洪水最嚴重的衝擊。

quiz.stem: Lisa was upset to learn that the secret she had told her best friend in ______ had been shared with the whole class.
quiz.explain_zh: confidence＝保密；in confidence 指私下、祕密地告知。她只告訴好友的祕密竟傳遍全班。
